text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaaaah---! I lost again! It's a losing 
streak!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Falling behind in a contest of wills and 
strength is proof that my power is still 
lacking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I won't... I won't ever forgive myself for 
being this weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I have to retrain myself right now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo, hoo...! We cannot afford to 
waste a single second!!
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush—let's keep training 
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Y-You're right... Even if I rush, 
muscles don't just grow overnight, do 
they...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But if I'm not doing muscle 
training, I feel like I'm gonna get super 
depressedーーー!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
F-For pity's sake, please, just let me do 
100 squats!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! "Time is muscle!" That's the 
motto!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A body you've trained will never betray 
you. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep working MUUUUSCLE harder, 
better, and FASTERーー!!
